name: show
description: Show one commit: its author, date, full message and the diff it introduced. Use when git/log gave you a sha and you need to know what that commit actually did.

ref.description: The commit to show: a sha, a branch, a tag, or an expression like "HEAD~2". Defaults to the current commit.

path.description: Show only what this commit did to this path, relative to the workspace root. Must resolve inside it.

summary.description: One line per file with a count of added and removed lines, instead of the diff itself.

max_lines.description: Maximum number of lines to return. The output says so when it truncates.

output_schema.description: A "commit <full sha>", "author <name> <email>" and "date <YYYY-MM-DD>" header, then the message, then the diff. A merge commit carries no diff, because git cannot choose a parent to compare against; the header and message are still returned. Longer than max_lines is followed by a "[git/show] truncated: ..." notice.

exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or a parameter is the wrong type)
exit_codes.3: not found (the ref does not resolve to a commit, or the path does not exist)
exit_codes.4: not permitted (the git repository is above the workspace root, or the path leaves it)
exit_codes.5: no repository (the workspace is not a git repository, or git is not installed)
